name: Add Activity
description: Adds a new activity. Includes `more_activities_scheduled_in_context` property in response's `additional_data` which indicates whether there are more undone activities scheduled with the same deal, person or organization (depending on the supplied data). See the Pipedrive API docs for Activities [here](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1/#!/Activities). For info on [adding an activity in Pipedrive](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1/Activities#addActivity)

configurable_props.name: type
configurable_props.label: Type
configurable_props.description: Type of the activity. This is in correlation with the `key_string` parameter of ActivityTypes.

configurable_props.name: ownerId
configurable_props.label: User ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the user whom the activity will be assigned to. If omitted, the activity will be assigned to the authorized user.

configurable_props.name: dealId
configurable_props.label: Deal ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the deal this activity will be associated with

configurable_props.name: leadId
configurable_props.label: Lead ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the lead this activity will be associated with

configurable_props.name: orgId
configurable_props.label: Organization ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the organization this activity will be associated with

configurable_props.name: projectId
configurable_props.label: Project ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the project this activity will be associated with

configurable_props.name: dueDate
configurable_props.label: Due Date
configurable_props.description: Due date of the activity. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`

configurable_props.name: dueTime
configurable_props.label: Due Time
configurable_props.description: Due time of the activity in UTC. Format: `HH:MM`

configurable_props.name: busy
configurable_props.label: Busy
configurable_props.description: Set the activity as 'Busy' or 'Free'. If the flag is set to true, your customers will not be able to book that time slot through any Scheduler links

configurable_props.name: done
configurable_props.label: Done
configurable_props.description: Whether the activity is done or not.

configurable_props.name: location
configurable_props.label: Location
configurable_props.description: The address of the activity. Pipedrive will automatically check if the location matches a geo-location on Google maps.

configurable_props.name: participants
configurable_props.label: Participants
configurable_props.description: List of multiple persons (participants) this activity will be associated with. If omitted, single participant from `person_id` field is used. It requires a structure as follows: `[{"person_id":1,"primary":true}]`

configurable_props.name: attendees
configurable_props.label: Attendees
configurable_props.description: Attendees of the activity. This can be either your existing Pipedrive contacts or an external email address. It requires a structure as follows: `[{"email":"mail@example.org"}]`

configurable_props.name: publicDescription
configurable_props.label: Public Description
configurable_props.description: Additional details about the activity that will be synced to your external calendar. Unlike the note added to the activity, the description will be publicly visible to any guests added to the activity.
